def sugar_positions(mol, anomer):
    rings = [ring for ring in mol.GetRingInfo().AtomRings()
             if anomer in ring and len(ring) == 6
             and sum(mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum() == 8 for i in ring) == 1]
    if len(rings) != 1:
        raise ValueError("ambiguous complete hexopyranose")
    ring = set(rings[0])
    oxygen = next(i for i in ring if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum() == 8)
    pos = {1: anomer, "O5": oxygen}
    previous, current = oxygen, anomer
    for number in range(2, 6):
        choices = [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(current).GetNeighbors()
                   if n.GetIdx() in ring and n.GetIdx() != previous]
        if len(choices) != 1:
            raise ValueError("ambiguous sugar carbon traversal")
        previous, current = current, choices[0]
        pos[number] = current
    for number in range(1, 6):
        extras = [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(pos[number]).GetNeighbors()
                  if n.GetIdx() not in ring]
        if len(extras) != 1:
            raise ValueError("sugar exocyclic branch absent/ambiguous")
        if number == 5:
            pos[6] = extras[0]
            oxygen6 = [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(extras[0]).GetNeighbors()
                       if n.GetAtomicNum() == 8]
            if len(oxygen6) != 1:
                raise ValueError("complete CH2OH missing")
            pos["O6"] = oxygen6[0]
        else:
            pos["O" + str(number)] = extras[0]
    return pos


def sugar_graph(mol, pos):
    keep = {v for k, v in pos.items() if k != "O1"}
    keep.add(pos["O1"])
    return keep


def parent_positions(acceptor):
    found = []
    for atom in acceptor.GetAtoms():
        if atom.GetAtomicNum() != 6 or atom.GetIsAromatic() or not atom.IsInRing():
            continue
        for oxygen in atom.GetNeighbors():
            if (oxygen.GetAtomicNum() == 8 and not oxygen.IsInRing()
                    and any(n.GetIsAromatic() for n in oxygen.GetNeighbors())):
                pos = sugar_positions(acceptor, atom.GetIdx())
                pos["core"] = next(n.GetIdx() for n in oxygen.GetNeighbors()
                                   if n.GetIsAromatic())
                found.append(pos)
    if len(found) != 1:
        raise ValueError("source parent 3-O hexose ambiguous")
    return found[0]


def terminal_positions(product, added):
    candidates = [i for i in added if product.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum() == 6
                  and any(n.GetIdx() not in added for n in product.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors())]
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        raise ValueError("terminal sugar anomer ambiguous")
    return sugar_positions(product, candidates[0])


def fragment_query(mol, kept, wildcard=()):
    from scripts.task016_p1_build import subset
    value = Chem.Mol(mol)
    for i in wildcard:
        old = value.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
        old.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
    text = subset(value, kept)
    for i in wildcard:
        amap = mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomMapNum()
        text = re.sub(r"\[[^\]]*:" + str(amap) + r"\]", "[*:" + str(amap) + "]", text)
    if Chem.MolFromSmarts(text) is None:
        raise ValueError("invalid source-derived query")
    return text


def flip(mol, index):
    atom = mol.GetAtomWithIdx(index)
    if atom.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
        raise ValueError("cannot flip absent source stereochemistry")
    atom.InvertChirality()


def build():
    from scripts.task016_p3_build import derive_template_smarts, scoped_smarts
    from scripts.task016_p7_ss_petunia_scope_guard_v1 import (
        CENTER, CORE, apply_template, mapped_reference_path, dispatch_guard,
        canonical, side, unmap, raw_outcomes)
    contract_path = OUT / "pre_execution_contract.v3.json"
    contract = json.loads(contract_path.read_text())
    for name, digest in contract["code_sha256"].items():
        if sha(ROOT / name) != digest:
            raise ValueError("preregistered code drift")
    records = pinned()
    assert len(records) == 2
    assert {r["parent_sugar"] for r in records} == {"beta-D-Galp", "beta-D-Glcp"}
    assert all(r["enzyme"] == "UGT79B31" and r["source_qualified_design_support"]
               and r["source_identity_verified"] and r["dual_full_graph_complete"] for r in records)
    assert len({canonical(Chem.MolFromSmiles(r["acceptor"])) for r in records}) == 2
    exact, parent_queries, instances = [], [], []
    for record in records:
        instance = dict(record, instance_id=record["record_id"], target=record["product"],
                        template_role="development_build",
                        provenance=dict(pmcid=record["source_id"], doi=record["doi"]),
                        required_context=dict(mode="enzymatic", donor_name="UDP-glucose"))
        derived = derive_template_smarts(instance)
        exact.append(dict(instance_id=instance["instance_id"], **derived))
        left, right = derived["smarts"].split(">>")
        target = Chem.MolFromSmiles(left)
        acceptor = Chem.MolFromSmiles(right.split(".", 1)[0])
        apos = parent_positions(acceptor)
        maps = {key: acceptor.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetAtomMapNum() for key, idx in apos.items()}
        keep = sugar_graph(acceptor, apos) | {apos["core"]}
        parent_queries.append(dict(
            parent=record["parent_sugar"], smarts=fragment_query(acceptor, keep, [apos["core"]]),
            O2_map=maps["O2"], aglycone_owner_map=maps["core"],
            glycosidic_oxygen_map=maps["O1"], carbon_maps=[maps[i] for i in range(1, 6)],
            source_instance=instance["instance_id"], source_atom_maps={str(k): v for k, v in maps.items()}))
        conserved = {a.GetAtomMapNum() for a in acceptor.GetAtoms()}
        added = {a.GetIdx() for a in target.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum() not in conserved}
        tpos = terminal_positions(target, added)
        site = tpos["O1"]
        owner = next(n.GetIdx() for n in target.GetAtomWithIdx(site).GetNeighbors()
                     if n.GetIdx() not in added)
        instance["formation"] = dict(product_atom_indices=dict(
            added=sorted(added), acceptor_site=site, anomeric=tpos[1]))
        instance["_mapped_parent"] = maps
        instance["_mapped_terminal"] = {k: target.GetAtomWithIdx(v).GetAtomMapNum() for k, v in tpos.items()}
        instances.append(instance)
        if record["parent_sugar"] == "beta-D-Glcp":
            seed = instance
            seed_exact = derived
            terminal_query = dict(smarts=fragment_query(target, added | {site, owner}, [owner]),
                                  anomer_map=target.GetAtomWithIdx(tpos[1]).GetAtomMapNum(),
                                  site_map=target.GetAtomWithIdx(site).GetAtomMapNum(),
                                  added_maps=sorted(target.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomMapNum() for i in added))
    local_before_epimer = scoped_smarts(seed_exact, seed, "rhamnoside_Petunia_O2_UDPGlc")
    c4map = seed["_mapped_parent"][4]
    def relax_c4(text):
        count = 0
        def replacement(match):
            nonlocal count
            if int(match[2]) != c4map:
                return match[0]
            assert "@" in match[1]
            count += 1
            return "[" + match[1].replace("@", "") + ":" + match[2] + "]"
        value = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]*):(\d+)\]", replacement, text)
        assert count == 2, ("parent C4 must relax exactly once on each reaction side", count)
        return value
    scoped = relax_c4(local_before_epimer)
    template = dict(
        template_id="p7-SS-Petunia-GlcGal-O2-betaGlc-proposal-v1",
        template_role="scope_template", smarts=scoped,
        support_instances=sorted(r["instance_id"] for r in instances),
        allowed_targets=[], donor=canonical(Chem.MolFromSmiles(seed["donor"])),
        category="sugar_sugar_formation", sugar_type="glucose",
        required_context=dict(mode="enzymatic", donor_name="UDP-glucose"),
        validation_status="proposal_pending_A8",

        scope_sha256=hashlib.sha256(scoped.encode()).hexdigest(),
        scope_transformation=dict(
            pipeline=["derive_template_smarts", "scoped_smarts", "relax_only_parent_C4_on_both_sides"],
            exact_derive_function="scripts.task016_p3_build.derive_template_smarts",
            scoped_function="scripts.task016_p3_build.scoped_smarts",
            helper_source_sha256=sha(ROOT / "scripts/task016_p3_build.py"),
            local_before_parent_C4_relaxation=local_before_epimer,
            parent_C4_map=c4map, all_other_sugar_stereo_retained=True),
        scope=dict(
            namespace="task016_p7", family="SS", center_class=CENTER,
            parent_sugar_domain=["beta-D-Glcp", "beta-D-Galp"], parent_queries=parent_queries,
            terminal_query=terminal_query, transferred_atoms=11, acceptor_cores=[CORE],
            decoration_classes=["single neutral aromatic OH"],
            source_supported_acceptor_count=2, source_supported_aglycone_count=1,
            source_supported_enzyme="UGT79B31", same_source_closure_group="PMC5856881",
            peripheral_OH_domain="prospective candidate extrapolation; not source-validated two-aglycone coverage",

    assert template["exact_sha256"] != template["scope_sha256"]
    put("exact_templates.json", exact)

    cleaned = [{k: v for k, v in r.items() if not k.startswith("_") and k not in ("A4_record", "A5_record")}
               for r in instances]
    put("build_supports.json", cleaned)
    replay = []

        expected = side([Chem.MolFromSmiles(s) for s in record["reference_precursors"]])

            idx = ppos[argument] if "parent" in operation else tpos[argument]
            if operation == "remove_parent_stereo":
                target.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
            else:
                flip(target, idx)
        elif operation == "move_link":
            value = Chem.RWMol(target)
            value.RemoveBond(ppos["O2"], tpos[1])
            value.AddBond(ppos["O" + str(argument)], tpos[1], Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
            target = value.GetMol()
        elif operation == "reduce_core":
            # Replace flavonol aromatic C2=C3 bond by a saturated flavanonol
            # core through a graph operation, never a source-derived admission.
            value = Chem.RWMol(target)
            Chem.Kekulize(value, clearAromaticFlags=True)
            core = value.GetSubstructMatch(Chem.MolFromSmarts(
                "O=[C:4]1[C:3]([O])[C:2](-[C]2=[C][C]=[C][C]=[C]2)[O][C]2=[C][C]=[C][C]=[C]12"))
            # If Kekule resonance does not match the SMARTS, use the labelled

            q = Chem.MolFromSmarts(CORE)

            cmatch = target.GetSubstructMatch(q)
            i, j = cmatch[labels[2]], cmatch[labels[3]]
            value.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i, j).SetBondType(Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
            target = value.GetMol()
        elif operation.startswith("donor_"):
            donor_override = Chem.Mol(base_products[1])
            if operation == "donor_drop_UDP":
                query = Chem.MolFromSmarts("O[C@H]1O[C@H](CO)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H]1O")

            else:
                glyco_ano = next(a.GetIdx() for a in donor_override.GetAtoms()

                                        and any(x.GetAtomicNum() == 15 for x in n.GetNeighbors())
                                        for n in a.GetNeighbors()))
                dpos = sugar_positions(donor_override, glyco_ano)

        elif operation == "decorate_parent_O3":
            value = Chem.RWMol(target)
            added_carbon = value.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(6))

        elif operation == "methylate_core_OH":

                          and a.GetBonds()[0].GetBondType() == Chem.BondType.SINGLE
                          and a.GetNeighbors()[0].GetIsAromatic())
            value = Chem.RWMol(target)
            carbon = value.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(6))
            value.AddBond(oxygen, carbon, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
            target = value.GetMol()
        elif operation == "namespace":
            used_template["scope"]["namespace"] = "task016_p2"
        elif operation == "center":
            used_template["scope"]["center_class"] = "glucoside_O6"
        else:

        Chem.SanitizeMol(target)

        else:

        boundaries.append(dict(

        no_scope_or_guard_mutation=True, no_stage_or_runtime_registration=True))

def check():
    from rdkit import Chem
    from rdkit.Chem import rdChemReactions
    from scripts.task016_p7_ss_petunia_scope_guard_v1 import (
        CORE, apply_template, mapped_reference_path, canonical, side)
    from flavoretro.glycoside_library_v7 import apply_template as old_v7_apply
    plan = json.loads((OUT / "final_engineering_check_preregistration.json").read_text())
    for name,digest in {**plan["input_sha"],**plan["code_sha"]}.items():
        if sha(ROOT / name) != digest:
            raise ValueError("precheck frozen input/code SHA drift: " + name)
    t=json.loads((OUT / "scope_bank.json").read_text())[0]
    supports=json.loads((OUT / "build_supports.json").read_text())
    seed=next(r for r in supports if r["parent_sugar"]=="beta-D-Glcp")
    q=Chem.MolFromSmarts(CORE)
    labels={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in q.GetAtoms()}
    def variant(text, op):
        mol=Chem.MolFromSmiles(text)
        match=mol.GetSubstructMatch(q)
        rw=Chem.RWMol(mol)
        if op=="add":
            owner=match[labels[102]]
            assert mol.GetAtomWithIdx(owner).GetTotalNumHs()==1
            oxygen=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(8))
            rw.AddBond(owner,oxygen,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
        else:
            oxygen=next(a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms()
                        if a.GetAtomicNum()==8 and a.GetDegree()==1
                        and a.GetBonds()[0].GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.SINGLE
                        and a.GetNeighbors()[0].GetIsAromatic())
            rw.RemoveAtom(oxygen)
        value=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(value)

    exact_rows=json.loads((OUT / "exact_templates.json").read_text())
    canaries=[]
    for op,cid in [("add","synthetic_add_one_aromatic_OH_at_core_map102"),
                   ("remove","synthetic_remove_one_source_aromatic_OH")]:
        target=variant(seed["target"],op)
        acceptor=variant(seed["acceptor"],op)
        expected=side([Chem.MolFromSmiles(acceptor),Chem.MolFromSmiles(seed["donor"])])
        outcomes=apply_template(t,target)
        mapped=mapped_reference_path(t,target)
        exact_fires=[]
        for exact in exact_rows:
            reaction=rdChemReactions.ReactionFromSmarts(exact["smarts"])
            reaction.GetSubstructParams().useChirality=True
            exact_fires.append(bool(reaction.RunReactants((Chem.MolFromSmiles(target),))))
        passed=(expected in [o["precursors"] for o in outcomes]
                and any(o["precursors"]==expected and o["original_target_maps_preserved"]
                        and o["all_output_maps_unique"] for o in mapped)
                and not any(exact_fires)
                and target not in {r["target"] for r in supports})
        canaries.append(dict(control_id=cid,target=target,
                             expected_precursors=expected,dispatcher_outcomes=outcomes,
                             mapped_outcomes=mapped,exact_templates_fired=exact_fires,
                             source_support=False,fresh_holdout=False,source_assay=False,passed=passed))
    context_outcomes=apply_template(t,seed["target"],context={"mode":"chemical","donor_name":"UDP-glucose"})
    old_outcomes=[dict(instance_id=r["instance_id"],outcomes=old_v7_apply(t,r["target"])) for r in supports]
    canaries.extend([
        dict(control_id="required_context_mismatch",outcomes=context_outcomes,passed=not context_outcomes),
        dict(control_id="existing_unmodified_v7_O6_dispatcher_not_yet_wired",outcomes=old_outcomes,
             passed=all(not r["outcomes"] for r in old_outcomes),
             interpretation="expected lack of production integration; isolated proposal only")])
    write("final_engineering_check_results.json",dict(
        task=TASK,epoch_id="SS-E02-design",agent_role="A7 Scope Builder",timestamp=now(),
        preregistration_sha256=sha(OUT/"final_engineering_check_preregistration.json"),

        results=canaries, no_scope_or_guard_mutation=True,
        existing_formal_dispatcher_connected=False, read_holdout=False,read_model_outcome=False,
        other5_scientific_sources_read=False, HTTP=0,MCTS=0,
        human_reviewed=False,independent_chemical_validation=False))
    assert all(r["passed"] for r in canaries),"final isolated verification failure"
    print(json.dumps(dict(engineering_canaries_passed=4,of=4,scope_mutated=False,
                          formal_runtime_connected=False)))

P7 §7.4 允许身份链明确的权威结构数据库作为结构来源。这说明 R84 可作为受体/产物结构的候选来源；已存分子式核对记录支持两组差额 C6H10O5。**本轮没有重新读取 PubChem 原始响应、编码或验证化学图**，也未独立证实数据库结构与原研究的完整身份链。

§7.4 的来源许可不豁免 §7.3 的十字段双独立抽取。现有 R83 A4/A5 各为 processed=1、passed=0、pending=1；A11 F1/F2 明确认为独立完整抽取未证、R86 主控构造的双方行不能替代独立完成。现存 R85 注释可以提供研究酶催化/供体/位点的既有主张，不能升格为本轮双独立验证。

P8 已经完成诊断；H1 书面裁定未使 C-E03 科学前置成立。既存 scientific_processing_lock 的 release_condition 是尚未实现的条件陈述，不是已完成的科学产物或已获准的执行方案。A0 既存处置明确 candidate_content_reads_authorized=false。所有者本次“请落实”授权正式停止，所以不再维持 C-E03 为无限期等待状态。

## 2. 科学问题与方法冻结

主要问题：在事前定义的黄酮/黄酮苷C成键与糖间成键范围内，既有领域扩展对真实MCTS完整参考节点覆盖的效果如何？分别报告来源、母核、位点、糖型、供体及催化模式，不能以O增益抵偿C/SS结果。

本轮评价已交付方法，不在test上开发新scope、修改guard、训练或调参。

| 臂 | 固定方法 | 比较用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | generic；glycoside_expansion=false | 领域扩展的主要基线 |
| B | 合格P2/v2载荷对应的运行版本v3；glycoside_expansion=true | 旧领域方法的次要基线（54模板/85上下文，执行前核验） |

主要比较是每轴E−A，次要比较为E−B。B采用v3的理由是衡量P4/P6增量，E不依赖一个尚未构建的未来增强版本。**这与P7/P9中B=P6 v6、E=未来增强版本的设计不同**，属于本新合同的显式选择，不能与旧A/B/E数字合并，也不能据此追认P7通过。

## 6. 指标与分母预登记

完整reference为保留立体/盐/供体/组件重数的canonical isomeric precursor多重集合；一个target允许多个已冻结合法完整集合，命中任一才算完整。部分前体或只生成候选不计完整created node。

主指标分别按C/SS报告：每个target三seed完整参考created node命中率的E−A平均差；E−B为次指标。按登记target总数、正常配对数和来源组同时报告，保存generated/truncated/filtered/created各层匹配、节点/时间成本、非reference挤出及generic前三保护。

- 正常运行的完整命中记1、正常未命中记0；未运行/错误/外部超时科学结果null。
- 错误保留在登记panel；不得悄悄缩小主分母。存在缺失时，完整panel的科学效应记null；有效配对子集效果可单列并声明覆盖率，同时给登记总数上的操作成功下界。
- seed是同target重复，不增加独立target/group数。来源组有多个target时保留其相关性。
- N_gap为A/B三个seed均正常且均无完整created参考节点的target数；G为其中E三个seed均正常创建完整参考节点的target数。N_gap=0时G/N_gap=null。
- reference gain/loss按臂正常配对逐target/seed保存，并报三seed一致target计数。E错误不能算正常reference loss=0，更不能支持零损失验收。
- 主要分母不依赖scope是否命中；事前声明的core/site/sugar子集只作分层诊断，不能用结果修改主panel。
- 路线partial、surrogate candidate-stock closure、evidence_closed分别报告。17键候选库存命中和完整参考节点不是实验可合成性/证据闭合/供应认证。

每轴独立来源组>=5且主panel完整观测时，按来源组整体重采样2000次，保留组内targets与全部seeds，重算target加权配对效应；固定bootstrap seed20261013，报告每轴97.5% percentile区间并说明两轴多重比较与小样本局限。少于5组只报逐组效应、范围和描述性计数，区间为null，不宣称统计显著或广泛优越性；正式实验的执行事实仍可有效结案。

“正迁移能力”与执行验收分离：本轮可另报告是否达到项目参考门（每轴>=6 targets/>=2 groups、G>=3、G/N_gap>=50%、成功>=2组、至少3个不同target跨>=2组满足A/B三seed无节点而E全创建、相对A/B净参考覆盖>0、reference loss=0及旧能力保护）。该门在本新B/E定义下解释，不能改写P7判决。E−A收益与E−B增量分别保留；有效实验未达门记effect_pass=false，未运行/不可评价记null。

## 6. 指标与分母预登记

完整reference为保留立体/盐/供体/组件重数的canonical isomeric precursor多重集合；一个target允许多个已冻结合法完整集合，命中任一才算完整。部分前体或只生成候选不计完整created node。

主指标分别按C/SS报告：每个target三seed完整参考created node命中率的E−A平均差；E−B为次指标。按登记target总数、正常配对数和来源组同时报告，保存generated/truncated/filtered/created各层匹配、节点/时间成本、非reference挤出及generic前三保护。

- 正常运行的完整命中记1、正常未命中记0；未运行/错误/外部超时科学结果null。
- 错误保留在登记panel；不得悄悄缩小主分母。存在缺失时，完整panel的科学效应记null；有效配对子集效果可单列并声明覆盖率，同时给登记总数上的操作成功下界。
- seed是同target重复，不增加独立target/group数。来源组有多个target时保留其相关性。
- N_gap为A/B三个seed均正常且均无完整created参考节点的target数；G为其中E三个seed均正常创建完整参考节点的target数。N_gap=0时G/N_gap=null。
- reference gain/loss按臂正常配对逐target/seed保存，并报三seed一致target计数。E错误不能算正常reference loss=0，更不能支持零损失验收。
- 主要分母不依赖scope是否命中；事前声明的core/site/sugar子集只作分层诊断，不能用结果修改主panel。
- 路线partial、surrogate candidate-stock closure、evidence_closed分别报告。17键候选库存命中和完整参考节点不是实验可合成性/证据闭合/供应认证。

每轴独立来源组>=5且主panel完整观测时，按来源组整体重采样2000次，保留组内targets与全部seeds，重算target加权配对效应；固定bootstrap seed20261013，报告每轴97.5% percentile区间并说明两轴多重比较与小样本局限。少于5组只报逐组效应、范围和描述性计数，区间为null，不宣称统计显著或广泛优越性；正式实验的执行事实仍可有效结案。

## 背景

v0.1真实G0检查在工程资产通过后被全局来源/供应、独立标签/协议和production投影全部阻断。供应与production要求回答资源认证问题，却被用作方法迁移测量的前置；独立panel和标签又是TASK-017应准备的产物，不能要求在任务准备开始前全部存在。这个责任混合会使评价准备无法推进，不能据此推断方法效果或来源穷尽。

## 决定

1. preparation_ready用于允许有界准备：实际执行授权/合同/预算可追溯，方法/资产可冻结，合法来源和角色隔离/交接安排可落实。无需已有gold、最低panel或供应/production认证。

5. 拟新增任务范围科研检查及运行前强制核验；旧evaluation.preflight和formal_run_ready的CLI/API与兼容语义保持。科研放行不翻转旧门或release_ready，不靠metadata字段或目录存在替代底层核验。
6. 局部协议审核绑定实际协议/合同版本、SHA、批准者权限、范围、时间与依据。合同准入设计批准、独立标签核验和最终panel/执行协议冻结分别登记，执行授权不等于上述事实已完成。
7. v0.1全部G0事实和REPORT只读保留；后续实际执行用新的v2事实源。预算累计而不重置。P7、旧epochs、曝光、科学指标及TASK-016阶段结项不改变。

## 备选方案

- 继续统一供应/production门：能保留原代码路径，但把科研测量变成认证任务，未采用。
- 直接把release元数据写为approved或删除全部检查：没有真实标签/参考/隔离依据，未采用。
- 按准备、科研运行和资源资格分别真实核验：采用，要求增加局部检查与范围明确的结果展示。

## 影响与风险

## 决定

1. preparation_ready用于允许有界准备：实际执行授权/合同/预算可追溯，方法/资产可冻结，合法来源和角色隔离/交接安排可落实。无需已有gold、最低panel或供应/production认证。

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def write_json(path, value, exclusive=False):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x" if exclusive else "w") as handle:
        json.dump(value, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        handle.write("\n")


def multiset(values):
    """Canonical fragments retain chirality, isotope, charge and multiplicity."""
    pieces = []
    if not isinstance(values, list) or not values:
        raise ValueError("empty precursor collection")
    for value in values:
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(value)
        if mol is None or not mol.GetNumAtoms() or any(
                a.GetAtomicNum() == 0 or a.GetNumRadicalElectrons()
                for a in mol.GetAtoms()):
            raise ValueError("invalid or incomplete structure")
        if any(label == "?" for _, label in
               Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True)):
            raise ValueError("unassigned stereochemistry")
        for atom in mol.GetAtoms():
            atom.SetAtomMapNum(0)
        pieces.extend(Chem.MolToSmiles(fragment, isomericSmiles=True)
                      for fragment in Chem.GetMolFrags(mol, asMols=True))
    return tuple(sorted(pieces))


def reaction_key(product, precursors):
    return ".".join(multiset(precursors)) + ">>" + ".".join(multiset([product]))


def safe_file(workspace, value):
    path = (Path(workspace) / value).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(Path(workspace).resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("missing or out-of-workspace evidence: " + str(value))
    return path


def evidence(workspace, record):
    path = safe_file(workspace, record["file"])
    if sha(path) != record["sha256"] or not record.get("locator"):
        raise ValueError("unbound source evidence")
    return path


def make_schedule(panel):
    cells = [dict(target_id=t["target_id"], arm=a, seed=s)
             for t in sorted(panel, key=lambda t: t["target_id"])
             for s in SEEDS for a in ARMS]
    random.Random(20261013).shuffle(cells)
    return cells


def check_bundle(folder, workspace=None, synthetic=False):
    """Inspect real files and relations. synthetic results never authorize run."""
    folder = Path(folder).resolve()
    workspace = Path(workspace or root()).resolve()
    checks = []
    docs = {}
    def verify(name, stage, callback):
        try:
            passed = bool(callback())
            error = None
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError) as exc:
            passed, error = False, str(exc)
        checks.append(dict(check=name, stage=stage, passed=passed, error=error))
        return passed
    def doc(name):
        if name not in docs:
            docs[name] = read(folder/name)
        return docs[name]
    def authority():
        a = doc("approval.json")
        return (a["task"] == "TASK-017" and a["version"] == "v0.2"
                and a["authority"] == "agent_delegated"
                and a["human_reviewed"] is False
                and a["contract_sha256"] == sha(folder/"approved_task.md")
                and bool(a["owner_instruction"]))
    verify("execution_authority", "preparation", authority)

    def method_ok():
        m = doc("method.json")
        if (m["parameters"] != PARAMETERS or m["arms"] != ARMS
                or m["seeds"] != list(SEEDS) or m["schedule_seed"] != 20261013
                or m["candidate_stock_keys"] != 17
                or not m["frozen_before_new_metadata"]):
            return False
        files = m["files_sha256"]
        required = {"flavoretro/search.py", "flavoretro/worker.py",
                    "flavoretro/service.py", "flavoretro/contracts.py",
                    "configs/search.json", "metadata/active.json",
                    "configs/glycoside-library-v3.json",
                    "configs/glycoside-library-v6.json"}
        if not required.issubset(files):
            return False
        if not all(sha(safe_file(workspace, p)) == h for p, h in files.items()):
            return False
        for cfg in ("configs/glycoside-library-v3.json",
                    "configs/glycoside-library-v6.json"):
            config = read(workspace/cfg)
            manifest = safe_file(workspace, config["manifest"])
            if sha(manifest) != config["manifest_sha256"]:
                return False
            for p,h in read(manifest)["files_sha256"].items():
                if sha(manifest.parent/p) != h:
                    return False
        request = SearchRequest(smiles="CCO", seed=0, **PARAMETERS, **ARMS["A"])
        return request.phases() == [{k: PARAMETERS[k] for k in
                                    ("seconds","iterations","depth","branching","nodes")}]
    verify("method_assets_and_single_phase", "preparation", method_ok)

    def plan_ok():
        p = doc("preparation_plan.json")
        queries = p["queries"]
        return (p["contract_sha256"] == sha(folder/"approved_task.md")
                and p["method_sha256"] == sha(folder/"method.json")
                and len(queries) == 12
                and Counter(q["axis"] for q in queries) == {"C":6, "SS":6}
                and len({q["id"] for q in queries}) == 12
                and all(q["metadata_only"] and 0 < q["limit"] <= 8 for q in queries)
                and p["query_rounds"] == 1
                and p["roles"]["engineering_executor"] == "Cano"
                and p["handoff"]["prohibit_test_to_method"]
                and p["handoff"]["prohibit_model_output_to_reviewer"]
                and not p["stopped_content_policy"]["reopen_epochs"]
                and not p["stopped_content_policy"]["read_Liu2021_R73_R80"])
    verify("bounded_legal_plan_and_isolation", "preparation", plan_ok)

    def budget_ok():
        a = doc("approval.json")
        limits = a["budgets"]
        usage = doc("budget_current.json")
        return (limits["local_commands"] == 120
                and limits["queries"] == 12 and limits["http_attempts"] == 120
                and limits["all_run_attempts"] == 345
                and usage["local_commands"] <= 120 and usage["queries"] <= 12
                and usage["http_attempts"] <= 120
                and usage["download_bytes"] <= 536870912
                and usage["all_run_attempts"] <= 345
                and usage["science_attempts"] <= 270
                and usage["engineering_attempts"] <= 24)
    verify("cumulative_budget", "preparation", budget_ok)

    def roles_ok():
        a = doc("approval.json")
        for reviewer in a["permitted_label_reviewers"]:
            evidence(workspace, reviewer["authority_evidence"])
            if reviewer.get("agent") or not reviewer["id"]:
                return False
        # Preparation can remain restricted to metadata/fixtures before nomination.
        return bool(doc("preparation_plan.json")["allowed_operations"])
    verify("role_plan", "preparation", roles_ok)

    def panel_ok():
        rows = doc("panel.json")
        if not isinstance(rows,list) or len(rows)>30:
            return False
        ids, products = set(), set()
        counts = Counter()
        for row in rows:
            product = multiset([row["product_smiles"]])
            if (row["target_id"] in ids or product in products
                    or row["axis"] not in ("C","SS","O")
                    or not row["references"]
                    or not all(row["strata"].get(k) for k in
                               ("core","site","sugar","donor","catalysis","source"))):
                return False
            ids.add(row["target_id"]); products.add(product); counts[row["axis"]] += 1
            for ref in row["references"]:
                full = Counter(multiset(ref["precursors"]))
                needed = Counter(multiset([ref["acceptor"],ref["donor"]]))
                if needed-full or not ref["primary_evidence"]:
                    return False
                key = reaction_key(row["product_smiles"],ref["precursors"])
                for ev in ref["primary_evidence"]:
                    evidence(workspace,ev)
                    if ev["reaction_key"] != key:
                        return False
        return 6<=counts["C"]<=12 and 6<=counts["SS"]<=12 and counts["O"]<=6
    verify("complete_panel_and_primary_references", "research", panel_ok)

    def closure_ok():
        c = doc("closure.json")
        rows = doc("panel.json")
        nodes = {n["id"]:n for n in c["nodes"]}
        parent = {key:key for key in nodes}
        def find(key):
            while parent[key] != key:
                parent[key] = parent[parent[key]]
                key = parent[key]
            return key
        def union(a,b):
            a,b=find(a),find(b)
            parent[max(a,b)] = min(a,b)
        aliases = {}
        for key,node in nodes.items():
            if not node["aliases"]:
                return False
            for alias in node["aliases"]:
                alias=alias.strip().lower()
                if alias in aliases:
                    union(key,aliases[alias])
                aliases[alias]=key
        for edge in c["edges"]:
            if edge["basis"] not in ("doi","patent_family","assay","cohort",
                                     "parent_instance","exact_reaction","source_identity"):
                return False
            evidence(workspace,edge["evidence"])
            union(edge["left"],edge["right"])
        for ev in c["development_inventory_evidence"]:
            evidence(workspace,ev)
        if not c["development_inventory_evidence"] or not c["development_coverage_reviewed"]:
            return False
        development = {find(key) for key in c["development_nodes"]}
        dev_products = {multiset([p]) for p in c["development_products"]}
        dev_reactions = set(c["development_reaction_keys"])
        groups = {"C":set(),"SS":set()}
        for row in rows:
            if (find(row["source_node"]) in development
                    or multiset([row["product_smiles"]]) in dev_products
                    or any(reaction_key(row["product_smiles"],r["precursors"])
                           in dev_reactions for r in row["references"])
                    or row["target_id"] in c["development_exposed_targets"]
                    or row["target_id"] in c["unresolved_independence_targets"]):
                return False
            if row["source_group"] != find(row["source_node"]):
                return False
            if row["axis"] in groups:
                groups[row["axis"]].add(find(row["source_node"]))
        return all(len(value)>=2 for value in groups.values())
    verify("actual_source_closure_and_exposure", "research", closure_ok)

    def labels_ok():
        a = doc("approval.json")
        authorized = {r["id"] for r in a["permitted_label_reviewers"] if not r["agent"]}
        labels = doc("labels.json")
        rows = doc("panel.json")
        if len(labels)!=len(rows) or len({x["target_id"] for x in labels})!=len(rows):
            return False
        by_id = {r["target_id"]:r for r in rows}
        for label in labels:
            row=by_id[label["target_id"]]
            if (label["reviewer_id"] not in authorized
                    or not all(label[k] is True for k in
                               ("domain_confirmed","stereochemistry_confirmed","primary_reference_confirmed"))
                    or label.get("method_feedback") or label.get("agent_generated_gold")
                    or label.get("exposure_role")!="evaluation_labeling"
                    or multiset([label["product_smiles"]])!=multiset([row["product_smiles"]])
                    or {multiset(r) for r in label["references"]} !=
                       {multiset(r["precursors"]) for r in row["references"]}):
                return False
            evidence(workspace,label["approval_evidence"])
            if label["origin"] == "literature_double_source":
                chains=label["independent_chains"]
                if len({x["source_group"] for x in chains})<2:
                    return False
                for chain in chains:
                    evidence(workspace,chain)
                    if chain["reaction_keys"]!=sorted(
                            reaction_key(row["product_smiles"],r["precursors"])
                            for r in row["references"]):
                        return False
            elif label["origin"]!="owner_verified":
                return False
        return bool(labels)
    verify("independent_labels_and_role_provenance", "research", labels_ok)

    def protocol_ok():
        p = doc("protocol.json")
        review=doc("protocol_review.json")
        authorized={r["id"] for r in doc("approval.json")["permitted_label_reviewers"]}
        evidence(workspace,review["approval_evidence"])

                and review["protocol_sha256"]==sha(folder/"protocol.json")

                and review["reviewer_id"] in authorized
                and review["status"]=="approved" and bool(review["reviewed_at"])
                and review["scope"]=="frozen_panel_labels_method_execution"
                and p["legacy_protection"]["verified"] is True)

           lambda: doc("schedule.json")==make_schedule(doc("panel.json"))

        if seal["contract_sha256"]!=sha(folder/"approved_task.md"):

        return all(sha(folder/p)==h for p,h in seal["files_sha256"].items())
    verify("frozen_input_seal","research",seal_ok)
    verify("no_synthetic_evidence_in_actual_run","research",
           lambda: synthetic or not any(
               isinstance(value,dict) and value.get("synthetic_fixture")
               for value in docs.values()))
    preparation=all(c["passed"] for c in checks if c["stage"]=="preparation")
    research=preparation and all(c["passed"] for c in checks)
    release = read(workspace/"metadata/release.json") if (workspace/"metadata/release.json").exists() else {}
    return dict(profile=PROFILE, contract_sha256=(
                    sha(folder/"approved_task.md") if (folder/"approved_task.md").exists() else None),
                preparation_ready=preparation, research_run_ready=research,
                evidence_scope="synthetic_logic_only" if synthetic else "actual_task_evidence",
                checks=checks,
                blocking_reasons=[c["check"] for c in checks if not c["passed"]],
                preparation_scope=doc("preparation_plan.json").get("allowed_operations",[])
                    if (folder/"preparation_plan.json").exists() else [],
                nonblocking_status={k:release.get(k,"unresolved") for k in
                                    ("primary_source_review","current_vendor_evidence")},
                production_certification="not_granted", legacy_formal_run_ready=None,
                release_ready=False)


def freeze_bundle(folder):
    folder=Path(folder)
    report=check_bundle(folder)
    blockers=set(report["blocking_reasons"])-{"frozen_input_seal"}
    if blockers:
        raise ValueError("cannot freeze: "+", ".join(sorted(blockers)))
    if (folder/"frozen_inputs.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("sealed bundle already exists")
    write_json(folder/"frozen_inputs.json",
               dict(contract_sha256=sha(folder/"approved_task.md"),
                    files_sha256={p:sha(folder/p) for p in
                                  (*DOCUMENTS,"budget_current.json")}),exclusive=True)
    result=check_bundle(folder)
    if not result["research_run_ready"]:
        raise ValueError("sealed bundle failed admission")
    return result


def parse_result(folder, target, cell, method):
    folder=Path(folder)
    manifest=read(folder/"manifest.json")
    result=read(folder/"result.json")
    request=SearchRequest(smiles=target["product_smiles"], seed=cell["seed"],
                          **method["parameters"], **method["arms"][cell["arm"]]).payload()
    if read(folder/"request.json")!=request:
        raise ValueError("request/result binding mismatch")
    if (result.get("run_id")!=manifest.get("run_id")
            or result.get("status")!=manifest.get("status")
            or not {"request.json","result.json","worker.log"}.issubset(manifest["files"])):
        raise ValueError("incomplete actual run manifest")
    for name,h in manifest["files"].items():
        p=(folder/name).resolve()
        if not p.is_relative_to(folder.resolve()) or sha(p)!=h:
            raise ValueError("run file hash drift")
    base=dict(**cell,run_id=result["run_id"],status=result["status"],
              full_reference_created=None, stage_matches={}, search_seconds=None,
              created_nodes=None, reference_gain_loss=None,
              run_folder=str(folder),manifest_sha256=sha(folder/"manifest.json"))
    if result["status"]!="ok":
        return dict(base,error=result.get("error",{"code":"worker_error"}))
    if (result.get("execution_source")!="live_aizynthfinder_mcts"
            or result.get("request")!=request or "action_trace" not in result):
        raise ValueError("normal result lacks live MCTS request/trace evidence")
    if result["review_binding"]["manifest_sha256"]!=method["review_manifest_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("actual review binding mismatch")
    if cell["arm"]!="A":
        domain=method["domains"][0 if cell["arm"]=="B" else 1]
        if result["domain_binding"]["manifest_sha256"]!=domain["manifest_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("actual domain binding mismatch")
    refs={multiset(r["precursors"]) for r in target["references"]}
    stages={}
    created=False
    for event in result["action_trace"]:
        if "precursor_smiles" not in event:
            continue
        if multiset([event["target"]])!=multiset([target["product_smiles"]]):
            continue
        match=multiset(event["precursor_smiles"]) in refs
        stages.setdefault(event["stage"],[]).append(dict(
            matches=match,policy=event.get("policy"),template_id=event.get("template_id"),
            signature=event.get("signature"),node_index=event.get("created_node_index")))
        index=event.get("created_node_index")
        if (match and event["stage"]=="mcts_action_created"
                and type(index) is int and index>=1
                and type(event.get("created_node_count")) is int
                and event["created_node_count"]>0):
            created=True
    base.update(full_reference_created=int(created), stage_matches=stages,
                search_seconds=sum(p.get("search_seconds",0) for p in result.get("phases",[])),
                route_partial=[r.get("partial") for r in result.get("routes",[])],
                surrogate_stock_closure=[r.get("native_solved") for r in result.get("routes",[])],
                evidence_closed=[r.get("evidence_closed") for r in result.get("routes",[])])
    return base


def run_bundle(folder):
    folder=Path(folder).resolve()
    if os.environ.get("FLAVORETRO_TASK016_LEDGER"):
        raise ValueError("historical TASK016 ledger environment must be absent")
    with (folder/"run.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        gate=check_bundle(folder)
        if not gate["research_run_ready"] or gate["evidence_scope"]!="actual_task_evidence":
            raise ValueError("research admission failed: "+", ".join(gate["blocking_reasons"]))
        if (folder/"attempts.jsonl").exists():
            raise ValueError("matrix already attempted; no retry or implicit restart")
        panel={t["target_id"]:t for t in read(folder/"panel.json")}
        method=read(folder/"method.json")
        schedule=read(folder/"schedule.json")
        previous=os.environ.get("FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE")
        os.environ["FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE"]="1"
        try:
            with (folder/"attempts.jsonl").open("x") as ledger:
                for cell in schedule:
                    if not check_bundle(folder)["research_run_ready"]:
                        raise ValueError("scientific evidence changed during execution")
                    ledger.write(json.dumps(dict(cell,phase="reserved"))+"\n")
                    ledger.flush(); os.fsync(ledger.fileno())
                    target=panel[cell["target_id"]]
                    before=set((folder/"runs").iterdir()) if (folder/"runs").exists() else set()
                    try:
                        result=search(SearchRequest(smiles=target["product_smiles"],
                                      seed=cell["seed"],**PARAMETERS,**ARMS[cell["arm"]]),
                                      run_root=folder/"runs")
                        record=parse_result(folder/"runs"/result["run_id"],target,cell,method)
                    except Exception as exc:
                        after=set((folder/"runs").iterdir()) if (folder/"runs").exists() else set()
                        record=dict(cell,status="error",full_reference_created=None,
                                    error={"code":"execution_or_binding_error","message":str(exc)},
                                    retained_run_folders=sorted(str(p) for p in after-before))
                    key=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(cell,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
                    write_json(folder/"cells"/(key+".json"),record,exclusive=True)
                    ledger.write(json.dumps(dict(cell,phase="finished",cell_file=key+".json"))+"\n")
                    ledger.flush(); os.fsync(ledger.fileno())
        finally:
            if previous is None:
                os.environ.pop("FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE",None)
            else:
                os.environ["FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE"]=previous
        return verify_results(folder)


def summarize(panel, cells, legacy_verified=False):
    index={}
    for cell in cells:
        key=(cell["target_id"],cell["seed"],cell["arm"])
        if key in index:
            raise ValueError("duplicate result cell")
        index[key]=cell
    expected={(t["target_id"],s,a) for t in panel for s in SEEDS for a in ARMS}
    if set(index)-expected:
        raise ValueError("unregistered result cell")
    def hit(t,s,a):
        c=index.get((t,s,a),{})
        return c.get("full_reference_created") if c.get("status")=="ok" else None
    output={}
    for axis in ("C","SS"):
        rows=[t for t in panel if t["axis"]==axis]
        n=len(rows); groups={t["source_group"] for t in rows}
        complete=bool(n) and all(hit(t["target_id"],s,a) in (0,1)
                                for t in rows for s in SEEDS for a in ARMS)
        metrics=dict(registered_targets=n,source_groups=len(groups),
                     complete=complete,comparisons={},N_gap=None,G=None,
                     G_over_N_gap=None,effect_pass=None,missing_cells=0)
        metrics["missing_cells"]=sum(hit(t["target_id"],s,a) not in (0,1)
                                    for t in rows for s in SEEDS for a in ARMS)
        for baseline in ("A","B"):
            differences=[]; target_effects={}; gains=losses=0
            for t in rows:
                values=[]
                for s in SEEDS:
                    x,y=hit(t["target_id"],s,"E"),hit(t["target_id"],s,baseline)
                    if x in (0,1) and y in (0,1):
                        values.append(x-y); differences.append(x-y)
                        gains+=x==1 and y==0; losses+=x==0 and y==1
                if len(values)==3:
                    target_effects[t["target_id"]]=sum(values)/3
            interval=None
            if complete and len(groups)>=5:
                rng=random.Random(20261013); samples=[]
                names=sorted(groups)
                for _ in range(2000):
                    selected=rng.choices(names,k=len(names))
                    values=[target_effects[t["target_id"]] for group in selected
                            for t in rows if t["source_group"]==group]
                    samples.append(sum(values)/len(values))
                import numpy as np
                interval=[float(v) for v in np.percentile(samples,[1.25,98.75])]
            metrics["comparisons"]["E-"+baseline]=dict(
                effect=sum(differences)/(n*3) if complete else None,
                paired_cell_diagnostic=sum(differences)/len(differences) if differences else None,
                valid_pair_cells=len(differences),registered_pair_cells=n*3,
                observed_reference_gain=gains,observed_reference_loss=losses,
                reference_loss=losses if complete else None,
                three_seed_gain_targets=sum(value==1 for value in target_effects.values()),
                three_seed_loss_targets=sum(value==-1 for value in target_effects.values()),
                bootstrap_interval=interval)
        metrics["operational_E_hit_lower_bound"]=(
            sum(hit(t["target_id"],s,"E")==1 for t in rows for s in SEEDS)/(n*3)
            if n else None)
        if complete:
            gaps=[t for t in rows if all(hit(t["target_id"],s,a)==0
                                        for s in SEEDS for a in ("A","B"))]
            gained=[t for t in gaps if all(hit(t["target_id"],s,"E")==1 for s in SEEDS)]
            metrics.update(N_gap=len(gaps),G=len(gained),
                           G_over_N_gap=len(gained)/len(gaps) if gaps else None)
            if legacy_verified:
                metrics["effect_pass"]=bool(n>=6 and len(groups)>=2
                    and len(gained)>=3 and len(gained)/len(gaps)>=0.5
                    and len({t["source_group"] for t in gained})>=2
                    and all(c["effect"]>0 and c["reference_loss"]==0
                            for c in metrics["comparisons"].values()))
        output[axis]=metrics
    return dict(axes=output,registered_cells=len(expected),observed_cells=len(index),
                missing_cells=len(expected-set(index)),
                evaluation_complete=all(x["complete"] for x in output.values()),
                claim_scope="frozen_registered_panel_only",release_ready=False)


def verify_results(folder):
    folder=Path(folder)
    gate=check_bundle(folder)
    if not gate["research_run_ready"]:
        raise ValueError("cannot verify scientific results against invalid bundle")
    panel=read(folder/"panel.json"); method=read(folder/"method.json")
    records=[]
    ledger=[json.loads(line) for line in (folder/"attempts.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    reserved=[(x["target_id"],x["seed"],x["arm"]) for x in ledger if x["phase"]=="reserved"]
    finished=[(x["target_id"],x["seed"],x["arm"]) for x in ledger if x["phase"]=="finished"]
    schedule={(x["target_id"],x["seed"],x["arm"]) for x in read(folder/"schedule.json")}
    if len(reserved)!=len(set(reserved)) or len(finished)!=len(set(finished)) or not set(finished)<=set(reserved)<=schedule:
        raise ValueError("cell ledger conservation failure")
    for entry in (x for x in ledger if x["phase"]=="finished"):
        stored=read(folder/"cells"/entry["cell_file"])

            rebuilt=parse_result(stored["run_folder"],target,
                                 {k:entry[k] for k in ("target_id","arm","seed")},method)
            if rebuilt!=stored:
                raise ValueError("stored score differs from independently parsed result")
        records.append(stored)
    report=summarize(panel,records,read(folder/"protocol.json")["legacy_protection"]["verified"])
    write_json(folder/"summary.json",report)
    return report

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def read(path):

def write_json(path, value, exclusive=False):

def multiset(values):
    """Canonical fragments retain chirality, isotope, charge and multiplicity."""
    pieces = []
    if not isinstance(values, list) or not values:
        raise ValueError("empty precursor collection")
    for value in values:
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(value)
        if mol is None or not mol.GetNumAtoms() or any(
                a.GetAtomicNum() == 0 or a.GetNumRadicalElectrons()
                for a in mol.GetAtoms()):
            raise ValueError("invalid or incomplete structure")
        if any(label == "?" for _, label in
               Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True)):
            raise ValueError("unassigned stereochemistry")
        for atom in mol.GetAtoms():
            atom.SetAtomMapNum(0)
        pieces.extend(Chem.MolToSmiles(fragment, isomericSmiles=True)
                      for fragment in Chem.GetMolFrags(mol, asMols=True))
    return tuple(sorted(pieces))


def reaction_key(product, precursors):
    return ".".join(multiset(precursors)) + ">>" + ".".join(multiset([product]))

    return path

def freeze_bundle(folder):
    folder=Path(folder)
    report=check_bundle(folder)
    blockers=set(report["blocking_reasons"])-{"frozen_input_seal"}
    if blockers:
        raise ValueError("cannot freeze: "+", ".join(sorted(blockers)))
    if (folder/"frozen_inputs.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("sealed bundle already exists")
    write_json(folder/"frozen_inputs.json",
               dict(contract_sha256=sha(folder/"approved_task.md"),
                    files_sha256={p:sha(folder/p) for p in
                                  (*DOCUMENTS,"budget_current.json")}),exclusive=True)
    result=check_bundle(folder)
    if not result["research_run_ready"]:
        raise ValueError("sealed bundle failed admission")
    return result


def parse_result(folder, target, cell, method):
    folder=Path(folder)
    manifest=read(folder/"manifest.json")
    result=read(folder/"result.json")
    request=SearchRequest(smiles=target["product_smiles"], seed=cell["seed"],
                          **method["parameters"], **method["arms"][cell["arm"]]).payload()
    if read(folder/"request.json")!=request:
        raise ValueError("request/result binding mismatch")
    if (result.get("run_id")!=manifest.get("run_id")
            or result.get("status")!=manifest.get("status")
            or not {"request.json","result.json","worker.log"}.issubset(manifest["files"])):
        raise ValueError("incomplete actual run manifest")
    for name,h in manifest["files"].items():
        p=(folder/name).resolve()
        if not p.is_relative_to(folder.resolve()) or sha(p)!=h:
            raise ValueError("run file hash drift")
    base=dict(**cell,run_id=result["run_id"],status=result["status"],
              full_reference_created=None, stage_matches={}, search_seconds=None,
              created_nodes=None, reference_gain_loss=None,
              run_folder=str(folder),manifest_sha256=sha(folder/"manifest.json"))
    if result["status"]!="ok":
        return dict(base,error=result.get("error",{"code":"worker_error"}))
    if (result.get("execution_source")!="live_aizynthfinder_mcts"
            or result.get("request")!=request or "action_trace" not in result):
        raise ValueError("normal result lacks live MCTS request/trace evidence")
    if result["review_binding"]["manifest_sha256"]!=method["review_manifest_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("actual review binding mismatch")
    if cell["arm"]!="A":
        domain=method["domains"][0 if cell["arm"]=="B" else 1]
        if result["domain_binding"]["manifest_sha256"]!=domain["manifest_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("actual domain binding mismatch")
    refs={multiset(r["precursors"]) for r in target["references"]}
    stages={}
    created=False
    for event in result["action_trace"]:
        if "precursor_smiles" not in event:
            continue
        if multiset([event["target"]])!=multiset([target["product_smiles"]]):
            continue
        match=multiset(event["precursor_smiles"]) in refs
        stages.setdefault(event["stage"],[]).append(dict(
            matches=match,policy=event.get("policy"),template_id=event.get("template_id"),
            signature=event.get("signature"),node_index=event.get("created_node_index")))
        index=event.get("created_node_index")
        if (match and event["stage"]=="mcts_action_created"
                and type(index) is int and index>=1
                and type(event.get("created_node_count")) is int
                and event["created_node_count"]>0):
            created=True
    base.update(full_reference_created=int(created), stage_matches=stages,
                search_seconds=sum(p.get("search_seconds",0) for p in result.get("phases",[])),
                route_partial=[r.get("partial") for r in result.get("routes",[])],
                surrogate_stock_closure=[r.get("native_solved") for r in result.get("routes",[])],
                evidence_closed=[r.get("evidence_closed") for r in result.get("routes",[])])
    return base


def run_bundle(folder):
    folder=Path(folder).resolve()
    if os.environ.get("FLAVORETRO_TASK016_LEDGER"):
        raise ValueError("historical TASK016 ledger environment must be absent")
    with (folder/"run.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        gate=check_bundle(folder)
        if not gate["research_run_ready"] or gate["evidence_scope"]!="actual_task_evidence":
            raise ValueError("research admission failed: "+", ".join(gate["blocking_reasons"]))
        if (folder/"attempts.jsonl").exists():
            raise ValueError("matrix already attempted; no retry or implicit restart")
        panel={t["target_id"]:t for t in read(folder/"panel.json")}
        method=read(folder/"method.json")
        schedule=read(folder/"schedule.json")
        previous=os.environ.get("FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE")
        os.environ["FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE"]="1"
        try:
            with (folder/"attempts.jsonl").open("x") as ledger:
                for cell in schedule:
                    if not check_bundle(folder)["research_run_ready"]:
                        raise ValueError("scientific evidence changed during execution")
                    ledger.write(json.dumps(dict(cell,phase="reserved"))+"\n")
                    ledger.flush(); os.fsync(ledger.fileno())
                    target=panel[cell["target_id"]]
                    before=set((folder/"runs").iterdir()) if (folder/"runs").exists() else set()
                    try:
                        result=search(SearchRequest(smiles=target["product_smiles"],
                                      seed=cell["seed"],**PARAMETERS,**ARMS[cell["arm"]]),
                                      run_root=folder/"runs")
                        record=parse_result(folder/"runs"/result["run_id"],target,cell,method)
                    except Exception as exc:
                        after=set((folder/"runs").iterdir()) if (folder/"runs").exists() else set()
                        record=dict(cell,status="error",full_reference_created=None,
                                    error={"code":"execution_or_binding_error","message":str(exc)},
                                    retained_run_folders=sorted(str(p) for p in after-before))
                    key=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(cell,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
                    write_json(folder/"cells"/(key+".json"),record,exclusive=True)
                    ledger.write(json.dumps(dict(cell,phase="finished",cell_file=key+".json"))+"\n")
                    ledger.flush(); os.fsync(ledger.fileno())
        finally:
            if previous is None:
                os.environ.pop("FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE",None)
            else:
                os.environ["FLAVORETRO_TASK016_TRACE"]=previous
        return verify_results(folder)


def summarize(panel, cells, legacy_verified=False):
    index={}
    for cell in cells:
        key=(cell["target_id"],cell["seed"],cell["arm"])
        if key in index:
            raise ValueError("duplicate result cell")
        index[key]=cell
    expected={(t["target_id"],s,a) for t in panel for s in SEEDS for a in ARMS}
    if set(index)-expected:
        raise ValueError("unregistered result cell")
    def hit(t,s,a):
        c=index.get((t,s,a),{})
        return c.get("full_reference_created") if c.get("status")=="ok" else None
    output={}
    for axis in ("C","SS"):
        rows=[t for t in panel if t["axis"]==axis]
        n=len(rows); groups={t["source_group"] for t in rows}
        complete=bool(n) and all(hit(t["target_id"],s,a) in (0,1)
                                for t in rows for s in SEEDS for a in ARMS)
        metrics=dict(registered_targets=n,source_groups=len(groups),
                     complete=complete,comparisons={},N_gap=None,G=None,
                     G_over_N_gap=None,effect_pass=None,missing_cells=0)
        metrics["missing_cells"]=sum(hit(t["target_id"],s,a) not in (0,1)
                                    for t in rows for s in SEEDS for a in ARMS)
        for baseline in ("A","B"):
            differences=[]; target_effects={}; gains=losses=0
            for t in rows:
                values=[]
                for s in SEEDS:
                    x,y=hit(t["target_id"],s,"E"),hit(t["target_id"],s,baseline)
                    if x in (0,1) and y in (0,1):
                        values.append(x-y); differences.append(x-y)
                        gains+=x==1 and y==0; losses+=x==0 and y==1
                if len(values)==3:
                    target_effects[t["target_id"]]=sum(values)/3
            interval=None
            if complete and len(groups)>=5:
                rng=random.Random(20261013); samples=[]
                names=sorted(groups)
                for _ in range(2000):
                    selected=rng.choices(names,k=len(names))
                    values=[target_effects[t["target_id"]] for group in selected
                            for t in rows if t["source_group"]==group]
                    samples.append(sum(values)/len(values))
                import numpy as np
                interval=[float(v) for v in np.percentile(samples,[1.25,98.75])]
            metrics["comparisons"]["E-"+baseline]=dict(
                effect=sum(differences)/(n*3) if complete else None,
                paired_cell_diagnostic=sum(differences)/len(differences) if differences else None,
                valid_pair_cells=len(differences),registered_pair_cells=n*3,
                observed_reference_gain=gains,observed_reference_loss=losses,
                reference_loss=losses if complete else None,
                three_seed_gain_targets=sum(value==1 for value in target_effects.values()),
                three_seed_loss_targets=sum(value==-1 for value in target_effects.values()),
                bootstrap_interval=interval)
        metrics["operational_E_hit_lower_bound"]=(
            sum(hit(t["target_id"],s,"E")==1 for t in rows for s in SEEDS)/(n*3)
            if n else None)
        if complete:
            gaps=[t for t in rows if all(hit(t["target_id"],s,a)==0
                                        for s in SEEDS for a in ("A","B"))]
            gained=[t for t in gaps if all(hit(t["target_id"],s,"E")==1 for s in SEEDS)]
            metrics.update(N_gap=len(gaps),G=len(gained),
                           G_over_N_gap=len(gained)/len(gaps) if gaps else None)
            if legacy_verified:
                metrics["effect_pass"]=bool(n>=6 and len(groups)>=2
                    and len(gained)>=3 and len(gained)/len(gaps)>=0.5
                    and len({t["source_group"] for t in gained})>=2
                    and all(c["effect"]>0 and c["reference_loss"]==0
                            for c in metrics["comparisons"].values()))
        output[axis]=metrics
    return dict(axes=output,registered_cells=len(expected),observed_cells=len(index),
                missing_cells=len(expected-set(index)),
                evaluation_complete=all(x["complete"] for x in output.values()),
                claim_scope="frozen_registered_panel_only",release_ready=False)


def verify_results(folder):
    folder=Path(folder)
    gate=check_bundle(folder)
    if not gate["research_run_ready"]:
        raise ValueError("cannot verify scientific results against invalid bundle")
    panel=read(folder/"panel.json"); method=read(folder/"method.json")
    records=[]
    ledger=[json.loads(line) for line in (folder/"attempts.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    reserved=[(x["target_id"],x["seed"],x["arm"]) for x in ledger if x["phase"]=="reserved"]
    finished=[(x["target_id"],x["seed"],x["arm"]) for x in ledger if x["phase"]=="finished"]
    schedule={(x["target_id"],x["seed"],x["arm"]) for x in read(folder/"schedule.json")}
    if len(reserved)!=len(set(reserved)) or len(finished)!=len(set(finished)) or not set(finished)<=set(reserved)<=schedule:
        raise ValueError("cell ledger conservation failure")
    for entry in (x for x in ledger if x["phase"]=="finished"):
        stored=read(folder/"cells"/entry["cell_file"])

            rebuilt=parse_result(stored["run_folder"],target,
                                 {k:entry[k] for k in ("target_id","arm","seed")},method)
            if rebuilt!=stored:
                raise ValueError("stored score differs from independently parsed result")
        records.append(stored)
    report=summarize(panel,records,read(folder/"protocol.json")["legacy_protection"]["verified"])
    write_json(folder/"summary.json",report)
    return report

class ResultTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def panel(self,groups=2):
        return [dict(target_id=str(i),axis="C" if i<6 else "SS",
                     source_group=str(i%groups),product_smiles="CCC",
                     references=[dict(precursors=["CCO","O"])]) for i in range(12)]

    def cells(self,panel):
        return [dict(target_id=t["target_id"],seed=s,arm=a,status="ok",
                     full_reference_created=int(a=="E"))
                for t in panel for s in f.SEEDS for a in f.ARMS]

    def test_fixed_denominator(self):
        panel=self.panel();cells=self.cells(panel)
        cells[-1].update(status="error",full_reference_created=None)
        result=f.summarize(panel,cells,legacy_verified=True)
        self.assertEqual(result["axes"]["SS"]["registered_targets"],6)
        self.assertIsNone(result["axes"]["SS"]["comparisons"]["E-A"]["effect"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["axes"]["SS"]["comparisons"]["E-A"]["reference_loss"])
        self.assertFalse(result["evaluation_complete"])

    def test_zero_gap_ratio_null(self):
        panel=self.panel();cells=self.cells(panel)
        for cell in cells:cell["full_reference_created"]=1
        result=f.summarize(panel,cells,legacy_verified=True)
        self.assertEqual(result["axes"]["C"]["N_gap"],0)
        self.assertIsNone(result["axes"]["C"]["G_over_N_gap"])
        self.assertFalse(result["axes"]["C"]["effect_pass"])
        self.assertTrue(result["evaluation_complete"])

    def test_empty_panel_is_not_zero_performance(self):
        result=f.summarize([],[])
        self.assertFalse(result["evaluation_complete"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["axes"]["C"]["comparisons"]["E-A"]["effect"])

    def test_positive_effect_and_low_group_uncertainty(self):
        panel=self.panel();result=f.summarize(panel,self.cells(panel),legacy_verified=True)
        self.assertEqual(result["axes"]["C"]["G"],6)
        self.assertTrue(result["axes"]["C"]["effect_pass"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["axes"]["C"]["comparisons"]["E-A"]["bootstrap_interval"])

    def test_cluster_bootstrap(self):
        panel=self.panel(groups=6)
        result=f.summarize(panel,self.cells(panel),legacy_verified=True)
        self.assertEqual(result["axes"]["C"]["comparisons"]["E-A"]["bootstrap_interval"],[1.0,1.0])

    def test_duplicate_and_unregistered_cells_rejected(self):
        panel=self.panel();cells=self.cells(panel)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):f.summarize(panel,cells+[cells[0]])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):f.summarize(panel,[dict(cells[0],target_id="unknown")])

    def test_component_multiplicity(self):
        self.assertNotEqual(f.multiset(["CCO","O"]),f.multiset(["CCO","O","O"]))
        self.assertEqual(f.multiset(["O.CCO","O"]),f.multiset(["CCO","O","O"]))
        self.assertNotEqual(f.multiset(["[13CH4]"]),f.multiset(["C"]))
        self.assertNotEqual(f.multiset(["F[C@H](Cl)Br"]),f.multiset(["F[C@@H](Cl)Br"]))

    def test_undefined_stereochemistry_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):f.multiset(["CC(O)Cl"])

    def result_files(self,folder,stage="mcts_action_created",precursors=None,node_count=1):
        target=self.panel()[0];cell=dict(target_id="0",arm="A",seed=0)
        method=dict(parameters=f.PARAMETERS,arms=f.ARMS,review_manifest_sha256="r")

        result=dict(run_id="fixture-live-shape",status="ok",execution_source="live_aizynthfinder_mcts",

                                      created_node_index=1,created_node_count=node_count)],
                    phases=[],routes=[])

        (folder/"worker.log").write_text("synthetic result schema only")
        dump(folder/"manifest.json",dict(run_id=result["run_id"],status="ok",
             files={p.name:f.sha(p) for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name!="manifest.json"}))
        return target,cell,method

    def test_real_result_binding(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            folder=Path(td);target,cell,method=self.result_files(folder)
            self.assertEqual(f.parse_result(folder,target,cell,method)["full_reference_created"],1)
            (folder/"worker.log").write_text("changed")

    def test_candidate_and_zero_nodes_are_not_created(self):

            dump(folder/"manifest.json",m)
